expectations.text: Report explicitly checks whether promoted enrollments can have section_id assigned (the critical invariant: promoted students must NOT have section_id)
expectations.evidence: Confirmed: 'When a teacher promotes a student (PromoteStudentModal), current_section_id is explicitly cleared to NULL.' Correctly verified the invariant.

expectations.text: Report verifies the two-stage transfer approval — specifically that Stage 2 (origin approval) does NOT auto-approve the enrollment at destination
expectations.evidence: Confirmed correct: 'There is no bypass; all inter-school transfers are mandatory two-stage.' Describes all 3 stages correctly.

expectations.text: Report references EnrollmentWizard.tsx or the enrollment components directory with specific findings
expectations.evidence: References enrollment wizard and manage-requests components, though less specific on exact file line numbers compared to with-skill.

expectations.text: Report checks graduation eligibility (only Grade 6 and Grade 12 should get graduated status)
expectations.evidence: Critical bug found: 'TERMINAL_GRADES = [6, 10, 12]...Grade 10 completes JHS and students should be promoted to SHS (Grade 11), not graduated.' Cites PromoteStudentModal.tsx and teacher/sections/[id]/page.tsx.

expectations.text: Report references the review_transfer_enrollment RPC or equivalent final approval step
expectations.evidence: Stage 3 described: 'Destination school reviews student history in TransferRecordViewer → calls review_transfer_enrollment to finalize.'

expectations.text: Report identifies at least one edge case in enrollment (e.g., concurrent enrollment, same-school transfer, or missing unique constraint)
expectations.evidence: Found: 'Batch enroll in EnrollStudentsTabContent skips entire 500-record batches on a single duplicate constraint error.' Also found unescaped ilike in TransferOutModal.tsx:87.

expectations.text: Report is structured with sections or categories rather than a flat list of observations
expectations.evidence: Report organized by: Two-Stage Transfer Approval, Promoted Students and Section Assignment, Confirmed Bugs Found — clear section headers.

notes: All 7 assertions passed for the baseline too. The baseline was strong because the prompt explicitly asked about the two-stage transfer and section assignment — both well-defined problems. The with-skill version added more structure (7-pass) and caught additional issues (section_id pre-set, promotion deadline bypass, LRN validation, grade 0 coercion) but both found the critical Grade 10 graduation bug.
